findings.title: Active O6 summary puts the reference-branch resistance on motor branches

evidence.observed: Current section2 says >=50 milliohm motor branches when explaining the <=0.6144A board-share bound.
D-R1-07 requires >=50mohm in each signal-reference branch and <=1mohm star transfer; it derives4*7.68mV/50mohm=0.6144A.
The operative servo harness worksheet correctly says reference branches.
Contacts1-4 are SERVO1-4_OUT; contact5 is GND. Motor supply/return are absent from this terminal.

evidence.measurement: Conditional bound with four5mohm reference branches is6.144A under the same7.68mV star-transfer assumption; a50mohm motor branch does not establish the0.6144A board-return bound. This is arithmetic, not an installed-current prediction.

evidence.maker_page: Not applicable: this is the owner-defined O6 harness contract, not a manufacturer rating.

findings.impact: A reader can measure or constrain the wrong wire branch while claiming the accepted board-return bound. The detailed assembly instruction is correct; no hardware failure or section2 violation is demonstrated.
findings.fix: Replace motor branches with signal-reference branches in the active R10_VALIDATION section2 paragraph. Preserve the >=50mohm reference/<=1mohm star conditions and the1A allowance; no CAD change is needed.

carried_qualification_limits.item: One switch/no powered physical break; ordinary0.15mm surface gaps and unfused pack stretch remain owner-selected risks. A later OUT-ground fault/failed-short Q124 can fire an enabled match. Two controls on one MCU are not independent software safety. Local coating and independent BlueJay remain mandatory.

No R10 firmware exists. Launch detection uses accelerometer+barometer; ground CONT/BUS hard-refuse; in-flight sensing never vetoes. Cold screen with both controls low precedes PC1, prior-enable discharge wait>=1s, then PE4-low settling>=100ms. Actual ADC/diode/leakage bands, reset/loader/trace locks and in-flight reset recovery need qualification.

Normal physical current including tail<=20ms, independent abort, no watchdog refresh while firing, postfire valid SAFETY refresh<=5ms, intact-hardware fault guard<=36ms. R134 hot pulses/current tail and shorted-match logic survival remain unmeasured. Actual selected-lot20ms firing and source/harness reserve are not proved by the maker0.5s datum.

No USB or self-powered port source when connecting an e-match; USB bench uses pack or e-match disconnected. GPS/radio are always powered/direct UART and have no off isolation/switch sensor. Camera isolation does not promise instantaneous power disconnection. Qualify rail access,7uA dry contacts,retention,RF/ESD,pack-star return and coating.
